EmailTemplate.description: Template to be used for case auto-response message to partner queries
EmailTemplate.name: Case - Partner Auto-Response
EmailTemplate.subject: Thanks for Contacting Admiral Business
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi there!
Thank you for getting in touch. Your request has been received and logged under Case {!Case.CaseNumber}.
Our team will review the details and get back to you as soon as possible.
If you need to reference this case in future correspondence, please include the case number in your subject line or message.
Have a great day,
Admiral Business Support Team
